criterion_instruction_final: Score how specifically the comment describes the mechanics of putting the rule into effect. Score 10 when it names concrete forms, responsible offices, transition steps, testing scenarios, timelines, or documentation requirements. Score 0 when it states only a general preference, with no workflow detail of any kind.
original_instruction: Score 10 when the comment identifies concrete forms, responsible offices, transition steps, testing scenarios, timelines, or documentation requirements; score 0 when it states only a general preference.
